headline: union SSL improves FD001->FD003 mainly by stabilizing Mamba state drift and strengthening the invariant path, not by activating the spec gate
interpretation_points: x_conv remains fully domain-separable by linear probe, but its MMD drops after SSL, so SSL does not erase domain cues at the frontend; it reduces their magnitude downstream.
The largest structural change is at the SSM state level: inv_state and mixed_state drift ratios collapse sharply after SSL.
The best target ablation after SSL is inv_only, which indicates the gain is mostly from a stronger invariant path rather than stronger spec routing.
Gate mean decreases after SSL, yet spec_feature_ratio increases, suggesting spec features become more concentrated/effective rather than simply more often opened.
